tool_input.command:
B=http://localhost:8081/api/v1; 
p(){ printf "%-8s %-45s %-30s -> " "$1" "$2" "${3:0:30}"; curl -s -o /tmp/b -w '%{http_code}' -X "$1" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' ${3:+--data "$3"} "$B$2"; echo " $(head -c 120 /tmp/b)"; }
# seed
T=$(curl -s -XPOST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' $B/tasks -d '{"title":"t1","priority":"HIGH"}' | jq .id); H=$(curl -s -XPOST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' $B/habits -d '{"name":"h1","frequency":"DAILY"}' | jq .id); L=$(curl -s -XPOST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' $B/learning-cards -d '{"title":"l1"}' | jq .id); echo T=$T H=$H L=$L
for ep in "POST /tasks" "PUT /tasks/$T" "POST /habits" "PUT /habits/$H" "POST /habits/$H/completions" "POST /learning-cards" "PUT /learning-cards/$L" "POST /learning-cards/$L/milestones" "POST /learning-cards/$L/notes" "POST /plans" "PUT /settings"; do set -- $ep; p $1 $2 '{bad'; p $1 $2 '[]'; p $1 $2 '"x"'; p $1 $2 ''; done
for r in tasks habits plans learning-cards; do p GET /$r/abc; p DELETE /$r/abc; p PUT /$r/abc '{}'; p GET /$r/99999999999999999999; done
p POST /tasks/abc/complete; p PATCH /plans/abc/items/x '{"done":true}'; p DELETE /habits/$H/completions/notadate; p POST /habits/$H/completions '{"date":"2026-13-45"}'
p GET "/tasks?status=NOPE"; p GET "/tasks?sort=nope"; p GET "/plans?status=NOPE"; p GET "/habits?active=maybe"; p GET "/tasks?priority=X"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='00-coverage.md'; out=[]
for line in open(p).read().splitlines():
    if line.startswith('| ') and line.endswith('| pending |') and 'M08' not in line:
        cols=[c.strip() for c in line.strip('|').split('|')]
        ms=sorted(set(re.findall(r'M0[1-7]', cols[1])))
        if 'M01–M07' in cols[1]: ms=['M01–M07']
        line=line[:-len('pending |')]+'pass (%s trial 1) |' % ', '.join(ms)
    out.append(line)
out += ['| D-05 errors are ProblemDetail, never 500 on bad input | M08 | A2, A3, A4 | pending |',
        '| Swagger contract: summaries, tags, 2xx schemas, ProblemDetail errors | M08 | A1 | pending |',
        '| Done-when: full regression + `./mvnw verify` on a fresh instance | M08 | A6 | pending |']
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
EOF
grep -E 'pending|M01–M07|PLAN-09' 00-coverage.md

cd /home/ahmoh/Documents/proj/QuickFlow && mkdir -p loops/backend-dev/outputs/evidence/M08/trial-1 && cd backend && ./mvnw -q verify > ../loops/backend-dev/outputs/evidence/M08/trial-1/verify.log 2>&1; echo "verify exit $?"

result:
Iteration 9 finished M08 (Hardening). Its first verification trial passed and the milestone is committed as `ae4a9c2`.

- **Swagger contract:** every endpoint already had a summary and a tag, but the audit found three real problems:
  - 19 operations had no success response in `openapi.json`, so their response schema was missing.
  - Every error response (400/404/409) showed the success schema instead of an error body.
  - Content types were `*/*`.

  I fixed all three in one place, a customizer in `common/config/OpenApiConfig.java`, plus one line in `application.yml`. I also documented the missing 404 on habit activate/deactivate. For the frontend this is additive only: no response schemas changed.
- **Bad input:** I tried about 120 bad requests (malformed JSON, wrong types, unknown enum values, non-numeric or oversized ids, wrong content type). None returned a 500; all return a proper error body with 400, 404, 405 or 415, so no code fix was needed.
- **Verification:**
  - Unit tests: 33/33.
  - New M08 suite: 254/254.
  - Every suite (M01–M08) on a fresh database: 606 checks, all green.
  - The seven list endpoints each answer in under 15 ms (the limit is 500 ms).
  - I published the new jar.
- **Not covered:** there's no separate check that data survives a server restart, because the dev start script always wipes the database. That requirement is still covered by the file-based database and the earlier M01/M05 checks. I noted this in the milestone file.
- **Coverage table:** statuses in `00-coverage.md` now reflect the earlier trial passes, and I added rows for the error-handling, Swagger contract and done-when checks.

`state.json` is valid JSON with `iteration` 9 and `last_iteration` set to M08. The dev server is stopped. All eight milestones are done, so the next iteration runs FINAL.

M08 Hardening passed on its first trial (606/606 checks, Swagger contract fixed) and is committed; FINAL is next.
